sources.entry: PaletteBrain - Access the power of ChatGPT across all your Mac applications with the press of a shortcut.

summary.name: PaletteBrain
summary.one_liner: PaletteBrain is a macOS app that brings ChatGPT/OpenAI (and Azure OpenAI) AI commands to any app or website via a keyboard shortcut, using your own API key.
use_cases: fix grammar and spelling in any app
create custom AI prompts bound to shortcuts
use ChatGPT in Gmail, Slack, or Notion without switching windows
refactor or explain code selected in an editor
summary.what_it_does: PaletteBrain is a macOS app that lets you select text in any application or website and run AI commands on it with a keyboard shortcut (the page cites Option+Space to open the command palette). Results can be pasted back into the original app with a shortcut. You can create custom commands, set prompts and model options such as creativity, and bind each command to its own shortcut. It also keeps conversations in one place with search, rename, and timestamp grouping, and supports deleting conversations. The app uses your own OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API key, and the page says usage is billed per use directly by OpenAI.
notable: Runs AI commands on selected text in any macOS app or website via a global shortcut
Bring your own OpenAI or Azure OpenAI key; pay-as-you-go with no middleman
One-time license (Personal $29 early-supporter price, Family $99, Team custom); lower-price offers are time-limited
caveats: Requires an OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API key; a ChatGPT Plus subscription does not cover usage
Explicitly macOS only; the FAQ question about Windows or Linux is listed but its answer is not in the page text

Page says the price will rise to $99/yr instead of lifetime; several features (multi-model support, AI agents, image attachments, file chat, conversation import, folders) are marked as coming soon and not yet available
